description: This PHP source file appears to be a component of the TestLink open-source testing management system. It handles generating reports on tests that are never run across all active builds by test plan and platform. The script includes functionality for initializing report parameters, rendering reports in HTML or Excel formats, exporting data via email or download, and managing UI components for these reports.
